summary.text: Tom Hatcher is a Republican state senator representing Tennessee Senate District 2 (Blount, Monroe, Polk and part of Bradley Counties), a member of the 114th General Assembly. He is second vice-chair of the Senate State and Local Government Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hatcher was born on May 20, 1958, is a retired circuit court clerk, and attended Roane State Community College.
He is married to Donna and has one child.
In the Senate he also serves on the Government Operations and Transportation and Safety committees.
